Power Meets Innovation in the 312 MD DualWave Laser Cap


The 312 MD DualWave Laser Cap is Kiierr’s most advanced hair growth device yet. Designed for both early and advanced hair loss, this cap features 312 medical-grade lasers and dual wavelengths (650nm + 808nm) to stimulate deeper layers of the scalp. The result? Faster, fuller, and more consistent hair regrowth where it matters most.

Unlike traditional red light therapy caps, the 312 MD uses two different laser wavelengths to target multiple depths of tissue. This combination increases blood flow, energizes weakened follicles, and helps restore hair from the root. Because it’s FDA-cleared, you can trust it’s safe and effective for at-home use.

This hands-free, cordless cap makes it easy to stay consistent. Just wear it for 30 minutes every other day while you go about your routine. No drugs, no messy foams, just powerful technology, proven by science.

If you’re comparing models, the 312 MD DualWave Laser Cap offers significantly broader coverage and deeper stimulation than other options, like our 272 Premier Cap. That’s what makes it the go-to for serious hair regrowth.

Thousands of people choose Kiierr every year because they want real results. You can be one of them. And with our Hair Growth Guarantee, you’ve got nothing to lose.

Want to know how it works? Read this clinical research article on the science behind low-level laser therapy (LLLT) for hair restoration.
